products.name: Pre-Logon VPN (PLAP / Start Before Logon) Troubleshooting & Diagnostics Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured diagnostic workflow and read-only tools for pre-logon VPN failures — isolate a missing precondition across both Cisco Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) and the Windows Always On VPN device tunnel in minutes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Find why pre-logon VPN isn't working — fast

When the Network sign-in tile never appears, the device tunnel silently never connects, or authentication is rejected, the fault hides among a handful of strict preconditions — and there are two different mechanisms that fail for different reasons. This toolkit gives you a structured diagnostic workflow and read-only PowerShell tools that isolate the missing precondition — for both Cisco Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) and the Windows Always On VPN device tunnel — in minutes instead of guessing. A self-guided troubleshooting playbook you keep and reuse on every incident.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — the failing precondition named for you, in a fixed check order, so the first FAIL is the whole reason.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every incident.
  • Tested — a diagnostic workflow (Collect → Analyze → Remediate → Verify) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the two pre-logon mechanisms and every precondition each needs: the SBL module + vpnplap64.dll PLAP provider + UseStartBeforeLogon; the device tunnel's SKU/join, single-tunnel, IKEv2, machine-cert, and AlwaysOn rules.
  • Requirements Guide — the device access, admin rights, and Intune/Graph read access to diagnose, each with how to verify it.
  • Diagnostic Workflow — the ordered Collect → Analyze → Remediate → Verify process and a symptom → tool map that sends you straight to the right check.
  • 5 PowerShell diagnostic tools — a master collector plus focused checks for SBL/PLAP, the device tunnel, the certificate, and the Intune object/scope audit. All read-only.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides — gates that prove the tool reports a known-good device healthy and a known-bad device's true fault, plus a comprehensive symptom → cause → fix matrix covering both mechanisms.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each incident feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next outage and the next project.

The bottom line

The missing precondition behind a broken pre-logon VPN — SBL/PLAP or device tunnel — isolated in minutes, with read-only tools you keep and reuse on every incident.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click toolkit: solution overview, requirements, the diagnostic workflow, testing, the symptom → cause → fix matrix, and best practices.
  • PowerShell Diagnostic Tools (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run, read-only tools (one master collector plus four focused checks — nothing is modified on the device, tenant, or gateway):
    • PLAPDX-Check-Certificate.ps1 — machine-certificate deep-check for pre-logon VPN authentication
    • PLAPDX-Check-DeviceTunnel.ps1 — focused Windows Always On VPN device-tunnel precondition check
    • PLAPDX-Check-Intune.ps1 — confirm the pre-logon VPN Intune objects exist, are assigned, and are correctly scoped
    • PLAPDX-Check-PlapSbl.ps1 — focused Cisco Start Before Logon (SBL/PLAP) precondition check on this device
    • PLAPDX-Collect-Diagnostics.ps1 — on-device master collector for pre-logon VPN (SBL/PLAP + device tunnel)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
